notes.title: Shorter Roads! Patch 0.0.2
notes.notes:
We hear you!

Shorter roads  are here!


v0.0.2 Patch notes:
- Added shorter roads
- Drivers change their speed based on their road length to keep the roads balanced

- Added destroy roads step to the tutorial
